checks.description: The configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint answered on /models
A real HTTP call returned a non-empty assistant reply, read back from the store
Every turn carried exactly the history the bound retains, in order, with correct roles and contents
The new conversation request carries the memory and no message from the earlier conversation
A memory saved before the new conversation appears inside the system message the server received
The stored personality version and values are present in every request of the main phase
Every main-phase request body declared the configured model id
No credential or authorization header value appears in any request body
For every failure that was actually provoked against a real socket, SQLite holds the user turn and no assistant turn

observations.note: turn-3 reply mentions 林一=true, 杭州=false, 后端=false. A 0.5B local model frequently fails this. The gating check above only proves the context was delivered, not that the model used it.
turn-4 reply mentions 杭州=false. The memory was delivered to the model; whether the model used it is a model-capability observation, not a system guarantee.

quality.note: No quality verdict is produced. A 0.5B local model is not evidence about reply quality, personality expression, or real-user usefulness in either direction. The observations above are model-capability notes, never gated.
